procedure: Pair the reference through BlueZ, verify bus 5 and HID identity 045e:0b13, read its sysfs report_descriptor, and compare all bytes with the upstream-described example. Review every HID short item, run tools/sanitize.py review-descriptor, and retain only descriptor bytes.
semantic_outcome: One reference produced a 283-byte descriptor identical to xbox-cgap-descriptor-example. The descriptor contains gamepad input 0x01 and four-actuator output 0x03, with no strings or opaque long items. Model label and installed firmware remain unconfirmed.
